items.headline: Chris Smalling joins Porto on free transfer after leaving Saudi Arabia
items.summary: Former Manchester United defender Chris Smalling, 36, has completed a move to Porto on a free transfer after leaving Saudi Pro League side Al-Fayha.

items.headline: Noussair Mazraoui substituted with injury during Morocco's 2-0 win over Lesotho
items.summary: Manchester United full-back Mazraoui was forced off with an apparent injury during Morocco's Africa Cup of Nations qualifier on Tuesday evening.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes ruled out of Portugal fixture with injury that has plagued him for weeks
items.summary: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes omitted from Portugal squad for Nations League match with significant injury concerns raised about medical management decisions.

items.headline: Patrick Dorgu returns to Old Trafford early with hamstring injury from Denmark duty
items.summary: Midfielder Patrick Dorgu limped out of Denmark's Nations League match against Wales with hamstring injury and has returned to Manchester United for medical assessment.

items.headline: Michael Carrick arranges behind-closed-doors friendly during international break
items.summary: Manchester United manager Michael Carrick has organised a secret friendly match with fellow INEOS-owned club to address poor form before Premier League returns.
